title: Over the Little Bridge
origin: Original score, effect cues and arrangement data authored directly for this workstream; no recording, sound font, external sample, third-party melody or random-note generation.
sourceBrief: Compose original music with recurring melody, deliberate harmony/bass, contrasting sections and cadences. Avoid random-note music. Provide the contracted scenes and restrained effects through the existing scheduler's event vocabulary; do not create another global AudioContext or preferences system. Music belongs on the host.
